crossRefs.note: Wake up! Why do you sleep, Lord? Arise! Don’t reject us forever.
Awake, awake, put on strength, arm of Yahweh! Awake, as in the days of old, the generations of ancient times. Isn’t it…
Isn’t it you who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep; who made the depths of the sea a way for the redeemed…
For we don’t have a high priest who can’t be touched with the feeling of our infirmities, but one who has been in all…
The floods have lifted up, Yahweh, the floods have lifted up their voice. The floods lift up their waves.
Above the voices of many waters, the mighty breakers of the sea, Yahweh on high is mighty.
Those who go down to the sea in ships, who do business in great waters;
if it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, when men rose up against us;
lightning and hail, snow and clouds; stormy wind, fulfilling his word;
“You afflicted, tossed with storms, and not comforted, behold, I will set your stones in beautiful colors, and lay your…
But before long, a stormy wind beat down from shore, which is called Euroclydon.

translations.web: But as they sailed, he fell asleep. A wind storm came down on the lake, and they were taking on dangerous amounts of water.
translations.bsb: As they sailed, He fell asleep, and a windstorm came down on the lake, so that the boat was being swamped, and they were in great danger.
translations.kjv: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water, and were in jeopardy.
translations.asv: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filling with water, and were in jeopardy.
